propositions: The documentation link checker must validate repository-relative Markdown links and images across a maintained source boundary that includes top-level docs, .agents, .github, docs, examples, infra, and test fixture directories.

Relative link targets must resolve from their source directory to any file within the repository; targets that escape the repository or refer to missing files must produce deterministic findings with source path, line number, raw target, normalized target, and failure reason.

The checker must ignore scheme-qualified targets, fragment-only targets, links within fenced code blocks, inline code spans, and reference-style links while stripping query strings and fragments before file resolution.
The duplicate outbound-link parser in test_all_docs_relative_links_resolve must be replaced with unified checker API.
Excluded Markdown sources (e.g., .joe-janitor, src/rebar/llm/reviewers) may remain valid link targets from included sources.
The maintained source boundary and parser behavior must be documented in docs/documentation-policy.md alongside existing top-level docs index-membership rules.
